questions.question: What did the Levites receive, since they had no tribal land?
options: A kingdom of their own to rule
A share of silver and gold instead
No portion at all in the land
Cities to live in, with pasturelands
questions.answer: Cities to live in, with pasturelands

questions.question: How many cities in all were given to the Levites?
Not one of God's good promises to Israel had failed; all came to pass.
The Levites were given _____ cities with their pasturelands.
Not one word of all the LORD's good _____ to Israel had failed.
